papers.sourceCoverage: Primary PDF pp. 415-434: abstract, methods, Table 1, Figures 1-2, quantitative and qualitative results, discussion and conclusion.

papers.sourceCoverage: Translated-first/original-second full text: English translation pp. 1-31; abstract, methods, Tables 1-7, results and discussion.

papers.blankStructuredFamilies: All results are psychological scale scores and regressions, so no Tabs 5-10 row maps cleanly.
